# Requirements Quality Checklist: Authentication and Bootstrap Administration

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency and measurable coverage of identity/access, first-admin enrollment, storage/recovery, UX and operability requirements before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-10-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth / Audience**: Standard-depth reviewer/PR gate for inventory 005.

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are production provider trust, verified login evidence and rejection without development/anonymous fallback fully specified independently of any particular identity vendor? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/002/015/019; §US1]
- [x] CHK002 Are stable external-to-internal identity requirements complete for concurrent first login, profile changes, distinct issuer/subject pairs and restart, without implicit account linking? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003; §US1.2/3; §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK003 Are all first-admin ceremony states and operator/nominee responsibilities defined, including explicit authorization, expiry, replacement before consumption, atomic enrollment and permanent closure afterward? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010-012; §US2; Operator contract §Nominate and enroll]

[Completeness, Spec §FR-005/007/021; §Interfaces and Permission Parity; Identity contract §Endpoint inventory]

- [x] CHK017 Are primary, cancelled, rejected, unavailable and corrected-retry login flows specified with safe local return continuity and no endless redirect or unverifiable-login fallback? [Coverage, Spec §US1.1/4/5; §US5.4; §FR-015/020]

## Edge Case Coverage

Global Authorization/mixed-credential refusal still applies at the adapter; not forwarding that header is not permission to authenticate it. Guide US3.1 explicitly requires both-path refusal. |

| CHK016 | Satisfied | SC-006/007, Required Validation and operator privacy distinguish required protected exchange from logs/pages/referrers/caches. Captures cover responses, redirects, logs/spans/metrics/IPC/events; real commit barriers distinguish unchanged/committed/uncertain. |
| CHK017 | Satisfied | US1.1/4/5 and US5.4 cover success, rejection, cancellation, outages and corrected retry. Identity endpoint/UI rules preserve only admitted local paths and allowlisted failure codes; retry is user-directed, never a fallback redirect loop. |
| CHK018 | Satisfied | Data model sessions make terminal revocation non-resurrectable, validate mode/epoch each request and prohibit positive cross-request caches. Operator reconciliation/rotation/key-loss paths retain mappings and revoke old continuity; guide US3.4 requires each boundary. |
